test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

R _ _ ODRMN _ _ _ MN _ DR _ NO _
solution:
• MNODROMD → R **M N** OD / RMN **O D / R** MN **O** D / R **M** NO **D**
 
• MNODRODM → R **M N** OD / RMN **O D / R** MN **O** D / R **D** NO **M**
 
• NMODROMD → R **N M** OD / RMN **O D / R** MN **O** D / R **M** NO **D**
 
• MNDOROMD → R **M N** OD / RMN **D O / R** MN **O** D / R **M** NO **D**

 
• In option 1, RMNOD is repeated.

Hence, ‘**MNODROMD**’ is the correct answer.
